name: nrf-4-5-4
description: NRF 4-5-4 retail calendar: year ends on the Saturday nearest 31 January, weeks start Sunday, periods 4-5-4 per quarter, extra week in period 12, years named by start year. Year bounds 2016-2030; quarters and periods of 2017 and 2023 (53-week years) and 2024; all weeks of 2023; navigation across year boundaries into and out of 53-week years; labels ('FY2023 Q01' is LABEL_NOT_RECOGNISED because {q} matches [1-9][0-9]?, with no leading zero). A shift case passes a Period whose start and days were edited, which the core must ignore.

source.citation: Independent implementation of the spec in conformance/generators/fiscal_oracle.py, written with Python datetime and no fiscalclock code
